subject: Promo voucher sweep and AR offset workflow — HarborTech pilot
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Promo voucher sweep and AR offset workflow — HarborTech pilot

Team,

HarborTech (HT) asked us to clear a promotional voucher balance tied to their pilot before we move to a paid contract. Background: we issued a $12,000 promotional voucher for the 3-month pilot; they consumed $4,200 so far and have an outstanding invoice (INV-2026-0043) for $5,600 due on 6/15. HarborTech prefers we sweep the remaining unused voucher value and apply any credit against INV-2026-0043.

Requesting finance guidance and the operational steps to:
- Issue an official credit memo to HarborTech for the unused portion (voucher remaining = $12,000 - $4,200 = $7,800)
- Apply that credit to INV-2026-0043 (invoice offset / AR netting)
- Journal entry classification and GLA mapping (promo contra-revenue vs. marketing expense)
- Any approvals needed for journal/ledger treatment and whether we need to route through Accounting ops first.

Attached: HT_promo_credit_memo_2026-05-30.pdf (stub), HarborTech_SOW_signed.pdf, promo_je_template_stephanie_v1.xlsx (draft).

Please advise next steps and if you need the signed approval noting Ben/AE sign-off (Ben — can you confirm authorization amount & deal id?)

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Promo voucher sweep and AR offset workflow — HarborTech pilot

Stephanie — thanks for the context. A few items from Finance before we post anything: 

1) GLA / JE classification: Is this being booked as a contra-revenue credit (account 4205) or as a marketing/promotional expense (account 6302)? Policy nuance: refunds/credits applied to customer invoices typically post as contra-revenue unless explicitly recorded as a marketing subsidy tied to a promotion reserve.

2) Reserve implication: Did we accrue any promo reserve for this voucher at the time of issuance? If yes, we should release the reserve (debit reserve account) rather than double-counting an expense. If not, we'll need to create the JE to reflect the reduction.

3) Approval: I need written confirmation from the rep (Ben) noting the approved sweep amount ($7,800) and that this is the final disposition for the pilot. Also confirm the target invoice to apply the credit to (INV-2026-0043).

4) AR posting mechanics: Finance can generate the credit memo and apply it to the invoice once we have customer confirmation and Ben's approval. The JE template attached is a draft — please complete the reference fields (deal id, invoice #, cost center).

If contra-revenue: JE would be
  Debit: Sales Returns & Allowances (4205) $7,800
  Credit: Accounts Receivable (1100) $7,800

If releasing reserve:
  Debit: Promo Reserve (2150) $7,800
  Credit: Accounts Receivable (1100) $7,800

I'll hold action until Ben confirms and we receive explicit customer ask.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Finance Manager — Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

From: Maria Alvarez <maria@harbortech.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Kevin Bryant <kevin.bryant@harbortech.com>, contracts@harbortech.com
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Promo voucher sweep and AR offset workflow — HarborTech pilot

Thanks Stephanie — HarborTech is on board with the sweep. Confirming: please issue a credit memo for the unused voucher amount ($7,800) and apply it to our outstanding invoice INV-2026-0043. We need the official credit memo PDF and a one-line confirmation that the credit will reduce the invoice balance before 6/15 billing cut.

Can you also confirm whether there will be any tax implications on your end for issuing this credit? Contracts is copied should they need to update paperwork.

Best,
Maria Alvarez
Director, Platform Ops — HarborTech
maria@harbortech.com

Confirming approval: I authorize the $7,800 voucher sweep for HarborTech (deal HT-2026-PILOT). Apply the credit to INV-2026-0043 as requested. No further commercial conditions.

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Maria Alvarez <maria@harbortech.com>, contracts@harbortech.com
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Promo voucher sweep and AR offset workflow — HarborTech pilot (final)

Thanks all — summary and requested actions below.

Summary:
- Promo voucher originally $12,000; consumption = $4,200; unused = $7,800.
- HarborTech has requested the unused amount be issued as a credit memo and applied to INV-2026-0043. Maria confirmed.
- Ben approved the sweep and confirmed deal HT-2026-PILOT.

Finance actions (Marcus/Laura):
1) Generate official credit memo PDF (use attached stub as reference) and post to AR referencing INV-2026-0043. Apply the credit to the invoice so the customer sees the reduced balance prior to 6/15 billing cut.
2) JE & GLA: Per internal policy and after consulting with Revenue Ops, please treat this as contra-revenue (Sales Returns & Allowances, acct 4205) unless you identify an existing promo reserve tied to HT-2026-PILOT. If a reserve exists, release Promo Reserve (acct 2150) instead. Use the JE template attached, complete fields: deal id, invoice #, AR customer id.
3) Tax note: Marcus, please indicate any tax adjustments on the credit memo (Maria asked); if none, include a note on the memo: "No additional tax liability — credit reflects unused promotional allowance."

Owner & timeline:
- Marcus/Laura: please post credit memo and JE by COB 6/10/2026 and confirm back on this thread when done.
- Ben: please retain this email as sales sign-off for audit.
- Maria/HarborTech: we will send the official memo to contracts@harbortech.com and to Maria.

Links and artifacts: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/HT-2026-PILOT), credit memo draft (Drive link above), DocuSign record for SOW.

If anything changes, flag here. Thanks everyone for the quick coordination.

—Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
